```{r, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(showtext)
library(JOUSBoost)


font_add_google("Nanum Gothic", "nanum")
showtext_auto()
```

# Load Dataset

```{r}
data <- read.csv("/Users/donghyunpark/Documents/Seoul National University/3rd year 1st semester/Data mining/2차 프로젝트/Dataset/train_set_encoded.csv", fileEncoding = "euc-kr")

data$target <- 2 * data$target - 1
```


```{r}
n = nrow(data)
K = 10 # 10-fold CV

# 설정하려는 Seed 총 개수
Seed_Num = 10
  
# Seed, parameter 별로 일단 모두 저장
Accuracy_adB <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
FPR_adB <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
FNR_adB <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
F1_adB <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)

# Parameter grid 설정
depth_grid <- c(2,3,5,8)
nround_grid <- c(100, 500)



for(seed in 1:Seed_Num){  # Seed를 다르게 하는 For loop
  print("seed")
  print(seed)
  set.seed(seed)
  
  # Parameter 별로 For loop
  for(depth in depth_grid){
    for(nround in nround_grid){
      print("depth")
      print(depth)
      print("nround")
      print(nround)
      
          for(CV in 1:K){
        ########################################################################################
        # CV generation. Train : Test를 9:1로 나눔 (이때의 train, test는 validation approach)  #
        ########################################################################################
            CV_index <- split(sample(1:n), rep(1:K, length.out = n))
            train <- data[-CV_index[[CV]], ] # Train set
            train_index <- c(1:n) 
            train_index <- train_index[-CV_index[[CV]]] # Train set의 index (필요할 경우 사용)
            test <- data[CV_index[[CV]], ] # Test set
            test_rowNum <- nrow(test) # Test set row Numbers (필요할 경우 사용))
        
        #################################################################
        # Modeling and Prediction. Update Accuracy, FNR, FPR, F1 score  #
        #################################################################
            Model <- adaboost(X = as.matrix(train[,-4]), y = train$target, tree_depth = depth, n_rounds = nround, verbose = FALSE)
            
            
            
            pred <- predict(Model, X = as.matrix(test[,-4]))
              
            # Update Scores
            Accuracy_adB[[seed]] <- c(Accuracy_adB[[seed]], mean(pred == test$target))
            FPR_adB[[seed]] <- c(FPR_adB[[seed]], mean((pred != test$target) & (test$target == 0)) / mean(test$target == 0))
            FNR_adB[[seed]] <- c(FNR_adB[[seed]], mean((pred != test$target) & (test$target == 1)) / mean(test$target == 1))
            F1_adB[[seed]] <- c(F1_adB[[seed]], 2*(mean((pred==test$target)&(test$target==1))/(mean(pred==1))*mean((pred==test$target)&(test$target==1))/(mean(test$target==1))) / (mean((pred==test$target)&(test$target==1))/(mean(pred==1))+mean((pred==test$target)&(test$target==1))/(mean(test$target==1))))
            
          }
        
      
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
# Seed, parameter 별로 CV에 대해 평균내어 모두 저장
CVAccuracy_adB <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
CVFPR_adB <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
CVFNR_adB <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
CVF1_adB <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)

for(seed in 1:Seed_Num){  # Seed를 다르게 하는 For loop
  # Parameter 별로 For loop
  for(param1 in 1:length(depth_grid)){
    for(param2 in 1:length(nround_grid)){
      CVAccuracy_adB[[seed]] <- c(CVAccuracy_adB[[seed]], mean(Accuracy_adB[[seed]][1:K + K * (param2 - 1) + K * length(param2_grid) * (param1 - 1)]))
      CVFPR_adB[[seed]] <- c(CVFPR_adB[[seed]], mean(FPR_adB[[seed]][1:K + K * (param2 - 1) + K * length(param2_grid) * (param1 - 1)]))
      CVFNR_adB[[seed]] <- c(CVFNR_adB[[seed]], mean(FNR_adB[[seed]][1:K + K * (param2 - 1) + K * length(param2_grid) * (param1 - 1)]))
      CVF1_adB[[seed]] <- c(CVF1_adB[[seed]], mean(F1_adB[[seed]][1:K + K * (param2 - 1) + K * length(param2_grid) * (param1 - 1)]))
    }
  }
}
```


# Accuracy

```{r}
adB_Accuracy <- as.data.frame(CVAccuracy_adB)
colnames(adB_Accuracy) <- c("CV1", "CV2", "CV3", "CV4", "CV5", "CV6", "CV7", "CV8", "CV9", "CV10")
adB_Accuracy <- as.data.frame(t(as.matrix(adB_Accuracy)))
```

```{r}
adB_Accuracy <- adB_Accuracy%>%
  gather(key = "Parameter", value = "Accuracy")%>%
  mutate(depth = depth_grid[((row_number()-1)%/%(K*length(nround_grid)))%%(length(depth_grid))+1])%>%
  mutate(nround = nround_grid[((row_number()-1)%/%K)%%(length(nround_grid))+1])%>%
  mutate(CV = (row_number()-1)%%K + 1)


adB_Accuracy
```


```{r}
adB_Accuracy%>%
  ggplot()+
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = Accuracy, y = Parameter))+
  theme_bw()+
  ggtitle("adaBoost Linear", subtitle = "Accuracy")
```

# F1

```{r}
adB_F1 <- as.data.frame(CVF1_adB)
colnames(adB_F1) <- c("CV1", "CV2", "CV3", "CV4", "CV5", "CV6", "CV7", "CV8", "CV9", "CV10")
adB_F1 <- as.data.frame(t(as.matrix(adB_F1)))
```

```{r}
adB_F1 <- adB_F1%>%
  gather(key = "Parameter", value = "F1")%>%
  mutate(depth = depth_grid[((row_number()-1)%/%(K*length(nround_grid)))%%(length(depth_grid))+1])%>%
  mutate(nround = nround_grid[((row_number()-1)%/%K)%%(length(nround_grid))+1])%>%
  mutate(CV = (row_number()-1)%%K + 1)


adB_F1
```

```{r}
adB_F1%>%
  ggplot()+
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = F1, y = Parameter))+
  theme_bw()+
  ggtitle("adaBoost Linear", subtitle = "F score")
```
